first_appearance_definition: The first visible portion within the clip that is identifiable and can be temporally matched to that subject; frame numbering starts at 0.

entities.name: Weapon B
entities.identification: The small metal pistol held by Person A in the foreground, with an exposed dark gray body and light-colored mottling.

entities.name: muddy shell-cratered ground
entities.identification: The undulating dark muddy ground and scattered gray rubble in the lower part of the image.

entities.name: cluster of ruined walls and rubble
entities.identification: The unevenly elevated gray ruined brick-and-stone walls and connected rubble in the middle and far distance.

entities.name: smoke-cloud-filled sky
entities.identification: The gray-white cloud layer in the upper part of the image and the gray-brown smoky background overlapping it.

entities.name: orange point of fire
entities.identification: The irregular orange-yellow open flame in front of the ruins and the nearby bright sparks.

entities.name: Person B
entities.identification: The person initially located in the center, wearing a helmet and dark uniform and carrying a backpack and Weapon C, who subsequently falls toward the lower left.

entities.name: Vehicle A
entities.identification: The dark gray-green armored vehicle bearing the text “F14,” with a top frame and large wraparound tracks.

entities.name: bright tracer burst
entities.identification: The briefly appearing slender orange-white glowing projectile trail.

entities.name: Person A
entities.identification: The person holding Weapon B in the first-person foreground view, with a dark glove, wrist, and gray-green cuff visible.

entities.name: Weapon C
entities.identification: The slender dark long gun that moves with Person B and extends along one side of their torso toward their legs.

entities.name: airborne debris
entities.identification: A collection of dark particles and irregular fragments scattered through the air.

At frame 0, the cluster of ruined walls and rubble consists of extensive gray to gray-black ruined brick-and-stone walls of uneven heights, with breaches and collapsed gaps among them.

At frame 0, the cluster of ruined walls and rubble consists of gray to gray-black ruined brick-and-stone walls with uneven heights and irregular breaches; the top edges are jagged, and some surfaces have light-colored remnants of plaster and exposed block-like masonry.

At frame 0, the smoke-cloud-filled sky consists mainly of gray-white cloud, with gray-brown smoke overlaid in the center; the clouds and smoke form clumps of varying darkness and soft gradients, and the upper right is brighter.

At frame 0, the orange point of fire is an irregular orange-yellow open flame among the ruins, with branching tongues of flame, a bright yellowish-white core, and tiny surrounding sparks visible; there is gray smoke in the adjacent area.
At frame 0, Person B wears a brimmed helmet and dark uniform and carries a relatively large brown-green backpack, with the slender Weapon C visible along one side of their body.

At frame 0, Person B wears a brimmed helmet and dark uniform and carries a relatively large brown-green backpack and the slender Weapon C; strap-like restraining structures are visible around the torso, pouch-like equipment is present at the side of the waist, and Weapon C extends downward along one side of the body.
At frame 0, only part of the side body, the end of a track, and the top frame of Vehicle A, a dark gray-green armored vehicle, are exposed, with the lower portion occluded by rubble.

At frame 0, only part of Vehicle A's dark gray-green armored side body, the end of a track, and the top frame are exposed; the surface is mottled and mud-covered, the text “F14” is legible on the side, light-colored block-like paintwork is visible, and the lower portion is occluded by rubble.
At frame 0, Weapon B is a small dark gray metal pistol with a body extending forward and a gripping section extending downward.

At frame 0, Weapon B is a small dark gray metal pistol with its body extending forward; the exposed surface has light-colored mottling and polished edges, and the downward-extending gripping section is mostly occluded by Person A's hand.

At frame 0, Person A's gripping hand wears a dark glove, with the fingers curved around Weapon B; the edge of the hand's outline has a lighter gray-green highlight, and the wrist is in the foreground.

At frame 0, Weapon C has the shape of a slender dark gun and extends diagonally downward along one side of Person B's body to near the legs; the exposed thin, straight section has a narrow bright edge, and the upper end is partially occluded by the body and equipment.

At frame 115, Vehicle A is a large dark gray-green tracked armored vehicle with large areas covered in mud; the slanted edge of the track wrapping around the body, a side-mounted short gun, and the top frame are visible; sections of the segmented track, circular rivet points, the muzzle, and the frame grid are discernible, and the side bears a light-outlined cross, a circular emblem, and the text “F14.”
